**Robert Bruce, Lord Kennet**

Robert Bruce, Lord Kennet (died 1748) was a Scottish advocate, legal scholar, and judge. **Early Life and Career**

Bruce was born into a prominent Scottish family and pursued a career in law. He became an advocate in 1696 and quickly gained a reputation as a skilled lawyer. In 1714, he was appointed as a judge of the Court of Session, Scotland's highest civil court, and took the title Lord Kennet. **Personal Life**

Lord Kennet married Helen Abercromby, who died in 1786. This marriage is documented in several sources, including the Scottish National Dictionary of Biography and the Oxford Dictionary of National Biography. [1][2]
